blocks.text: Upper Eagle Ridge Condos and Townhomes: streets and boundaries

items.t: The strata stock for this slope sits on Lansdowne Drive at the foot of the pocket, below the detached streets: the one complex with a municipal record is at 1170 Lansdowne Drive, on the same corridor as Eagle Ridge Elementary at 1215 Falcon Drive and the Eagle Ridge Park campus.
Lansdowne Drive addresses are not all filed under one sub-area name, so a condo buyer must search by civic address and strata plan, not by the words Upper Eagle Ridge alone.

blocks.text: Upper Eagle Ridge Condos and Townhomes: the housing stock

items.t: That conversion history is the stock's defining fact: a converted building carries conversion-era construction and a strata corporation formed from a rental building, so the depreciation report, the strata's Form B information certificate and the conversion disclosure are the documents that describe this complex, not a developer's sales material.

blocks.text: Upper Eagle Ridge Condos and Townhomes: rules that affect buyers

items.t: The strata-specific rule check here is the conversion record: because 1170 Lansdowne Drive reached strata title by a 1980 conversion application rather than new construction, a buyer confirms the strata plan, the common property and any conversion conditions from the strata's own filings and the City archives record, not from a marketing summary.

blocks.text: Upper Eagle Ridge Condos and Townhomes: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: The City's own archives are a working due-diligence tool for this slope's strata stock: the 1980 Subdivision Committee minutes for 1170 Lansdowne Drive are searchable in the Coquitlam archives, alongside the neighbourhood's storm drain and creek records.

Eagle Ridge Outdoor Pool at 2689 Guildford Way, a subfacility of Eagle Ridge Park below the pocket, is an eight-lane, 25-metre outdoor pool with 1-metre and 3-metre diving boards whose listed 2026 season ran May 30 to September 7 — seasonal amenity value only.

Eagle Ridge Park, entrance at 2635 Runnel Drive and fronting the Lansdowne Drive schools, puts its lacrosse box's four pickleball courts, four lit tennis courts, fields and playground at the foot of the strata corridor.

blocks.text: Upper Eagle Ridge Condos and Townhomes: costs and taxes

items.t: The Upper Eagle Ridge strata-specific cost check is building age by tenure, not by tax class: a conversion-era complex like 1170 Lansdowne Drive carries its capital costs in the strata's depreciation report and contingency reserve fund, which a buyer reads before offer, because no City page prices them.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Upper Eagle Ridge?
faq.a: The Greater Vancouver REALTORS® counted 3 condos and townhomes listed in Upper Eagle Ridge at the end of October 2026. The number changes daily, so ask Jared for today’s count.

faq.q: Is Upper Eagle Ridge a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In October 2026, condos and townhomes in Upper Eagle Ridge had a sales ratio of 33% on only 3 listed, too few to read as a market type. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Upper Eagle Ridge from June to October 2026?
faq.a: Between June and October 2026, 6 condos and townhomes sold in Upper Eagle Ridge; Coquitlam as a whole recorded 596.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.

faq.q: Is there really strata housing in Upper Eagle Ridge, or is it all houses?
faq.a: The strata anchor is at the foot of the slope, not on the upper streets. City archives record a strata title conversion application for 1170 Lansdowne Drive by Cressey Development Corporation in 1980, which makes that complex a converted rental building.

faq.q: What does the 1980 conversion at 1170 Lansdowne Drive mean for a buyer today?
faq.a: It means the building started as rental housing and was sold unit by unit under a conversion undertaking that existing tenants would not be ejected. For a resale buyer the practical checks are the strata's depreciation report, contingency reserve fund position and Form B, because a conversion-era building's remaining life on roof, plumbing and envelope systems is a document question, not something a listing states.

faq.q: Can I rely on a published rental or pet bylaw for the Lansdowne Drive complex?
faq.a: Strata rental and pet rules live in the strata corporation's own bylaws filed at the Land Title Office and summarised on the Form B a seller must provide, so the Form B and the current bylaw set are the only reliable source for this complex.

faq.q: What did townhomes in Upper Eagle Ridge sell for?
faq.a: From November 2025 to late October 2026, Upper Eagle Ridge recorded 8 townhome sales at a median of $861,000.

faq.q: How long do townhomes take to sell in Upper Eagle Ridge?
faq.a: Typical time on the market was 18 days. At the median, sale prices were 98.5% of list, and 12% of sales closed above list (November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026).
